title: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the row-level security policies on pem.job and pem.jobstep that apply to PEM…
description: Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM) versions prior to 10.6.1 have a row-level security policy flaw on pem.job and pem.jobstep tables that fails to restrict PEM agents to their own jobs. An attacker controlling one monitored host and its PEM agent certificate can manipulate jobs across all agents, including the PEM server agent. This can lead to execution of SQL and shell job steps with elevated database credentials, potentially granting superuser access to all monitored databases and the PEM backend. Starting from PEM 10.6.1, agents are prevented from creating or modifying jobs, mitigating this issue.
